blurb: Joe Testa is a Coast Guard Licensed fishing guide offering guided charter fishing trips targeting trophy bass, walleye, and lake trout. Trips take place on fully equipped boats with top-tier gear and insider knowledge of the best fishing spots. Locations include Lake George, NY, Lake Leelanau, MI, and Houghton Lake, MI, each known for specific fish species and seasonal availability.
extraNote: Lake George trips July 6 - August 15, 2026; Lake Leelanau trips season opener July 4, 2026; Houghton Lake trips season opener early June
